notes.title: 1.6 - Improved controller support
notes.notes:
Honk honk,

Since the Steam release, there are a lot of players that use the Steam Deck to play Obgoose. But the controller support lacked one major feature: Undo. With this new release, the goose can also revert mistakes on the controller with XBOX-LB.

One additional small change: I got the feedback that the doodle effect is irritating. I tried several things, but they either felt laggy or inconsistent. So as a compromise, I removed the doodle effect for letters only.

Cheers
